title: Change of name on a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card
summary: You can change your registered name on a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card by cancelling your existing card and applying for a new one online, or by visiting a Service NSW Centre or calling 13 77 88.
intro:
If you need to change your registered name on a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card, you can do so online by cancelling your existing card and then applying for a new card.

Alternatively, you can call 13 77 88 or visit a Service NSW Centre. You’ll need your Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card and a valid green Medicare card.

Your new card will be sent to you within 21 working days.

faqs.q: How do I change my name on my Seniors Card?
faqs.a: You can change your name by cancelling your existing card and then applying for a new card. You can also call 13 77 88 or visit a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get my new card?
faqs.a: Your new card will be sent to you within 21 working days.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my name?
faqs.a: You will need your Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card and a valid green Medicare card.
